content.short: HeroSwap enables virtually instant and anonymous cross-chain swaps with no signups.
content.description: HeroSwap enables near-instant, anonymous cross-chain swaps for any supported currency without signups. This capability helps developers attract new users and increase liquidity for their cross-chain applications, while everyday users can freely move value across chains to explore different blockchain ecosystems. By embedding HeroSwap, partners share in the economic rewards, receiving 50% of all swapping fees generated through their integrations and helping drive activity across multiple networks.
